name: goat-animation
description: Animation · Анимэйшн: no-camera animated videos for Reels/TikTok, drawn in code from a script and your own voice. Four styles: Wireframe (glowing line objects in the dark), Stage (soft objects on a lit stage with a paper-cut narrator made from your photo), Collage (halftone cut-outs, your own photos too, and big slamming words) and App Explainer (a graphing calculator). No API keys, no paid generators. Built on HyperFrames + three.js. Mongolian-first.
